proposal.summary: An XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in xmlstatus.cgi (webconfig menu.cgi) of MAN-EAM-0003 V3.2.4 allows an unauthenticated user to upload/paste an XML snapshot and retrieve local files such as /etc/passwd.

AC.quote: click on "View saved XML snapshot" and upload XML exploit file or paste the exploit code and submit the form

UI.quote: click on "View saved XML snapshot" and upload XML exploit file or paste the exploit code and submit the form

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the issue by reproducing the upload/paste steps in a controlled test environment, confirm XXE behavior, identify code paths parsing XML, and apply mitigations (disable external entity resolution or use a safe XML parser).

evidence_quotes.claim: Exploit steps to upload/paste XML and receive file contents
evidence_quotes.quote: click on "View saved XML snapshot" and upload XML exploit file or paste the exploit code and submit the form
